title: Bakewell Rice Pudding
description: SWAP THIS: We’ve used unsweetened almond milk to keep the calories down, but you can use whichever milk or milk alternative you prefer. Using semi-skimmed milk will increase the calories to 167 kcal
steps: Put the rice and unsweetened almond milk in a saucepan and bring to the boil, stirring occasionally, then turn the heat down to the lowest setting, cover loosely with a lid and simmer gently for 50 minutes, stirring frequently.
While the rice pudding cooks, prepare the compote topping.
Put the defrosted cherries (including any juices that have been released) in a small saucepan, along with the orange juice and sweetener.
Bring to the boil and cook rapidly for about 10 minutes or until the juices become syrupy.
When the rice pudding is cooked, take it off the heat and stir in the almond essence and sweetener (or sugar).
Leave it in the pan for 10 minutes before spooning into bowls.
Top with the cherry compote (warm or cold) and a sprinkle of flaked almonds.
Put the rice and almond milk in the slow cooker and cook on low for 6 hours.
